name: OpenClaw Skill Runtime
description: 在明确调用或读取 SKILL.md 时识别 skill，并预授权其声明的飞书 scope（metadata.openclaw.larkAuth）

blockRead.description: If true, block skill activation/read/execution until scopes are granted. Default true.

skillRoots.description: Override default skill root dirs to scan.

userOAuthRedirectUri.description: Redirect URI used to build Feishu/Lark end-user OAuth authorization links for identity:user grants.

userAuthProvider.description: User-identity authorization provider. lark-cli (default) uses Device Flow; context is an explicit compatibility mode that reads granted scopes from hook context profiles.

larkCliPath.description: Optional lark-cli command or absolute binary path used when userAuthProvider is lark-cli. Default lark-cli is resolved through PATH.

userAuthTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for lark-cli device flow waiting.

toolAuth.description: Optional explicit auth declarations for non-skill tool calls, keyed by OpenClaw tool name.

identity.description: Whether the tool uses app identity or user identity. Default user.

scopes.description: Feishu/Lark scopes required before the tool call can run.
